SELECT owner_id, last_name
FROM Owners
WHERE owner_id = (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM Dogs
    JOIN Treatments USING (dog_id)
    GROUP BY owner_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
FINAL SQL:
SELECT owner_id, last_name
FROM Owners
WHERE owner_id = (
    SELECT owner_id
    FROM Dogs
    JOIN Treatments USING (dog_id)
    GROUP BY owner_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
